DISPLAY CHOICES: PER PLACEMENT
|
|-- DiagramAlternatives
|   |-- items[id]: DiagramAlternative
|   |   |-- diagramId + presentationId + name
|   |   |-- parentAlternativeId? / reviewId?
|   |   `-- parts[]: one atomic choice
|   |       |-- target: whole diagram OR subtree nodeRef
|   |       |-- source: pinned revision + source scope
|   |       `-- baseRevisionId: target context
|   |-- selected[presentationId]: alternative IDs
|   `-- panels[id]: DiagramSidePanel
|       |-- attachment: presentationId + target nodeRef
|       |-- alternativeId + partIndex
|       `-- flow / overlay; regular / diff; left / right
|
|-- nodes.promoteAlternative
|   `-- pin existing revisions; disjoint parts, one base
|-- nodes.selectAlternative
|   |-- swap parts atomically; reject overlapping choices
|   `-- replace:true deselects overlaps; nested needs parent
|-- nodes.sidePanel
|   `-- compare a part beside its target; auto-place side
`-- Row projection
    `-- alternativeSelections -> resolveRevisionLines
        `-- projectSelectedDiagramRows: text + provenance

Whole-diagram diff alternatives show the full comparison.
Presentation selection creates no content revision.

Sources: diagramAlternative.ts / diagramAlternatives.ts
         diagramRevisionProjection.ts
